usd_reason: The US Treasury yields fell as oil prices plunged on Iran de-escalation hopes, which could lead to a stronger dollar
gold_reason: Lower oil prices and decreased geopolitical tensions could reduce demand for safe-haven assets like gold
indices_reason: The drop in oil prices and US Treasury yields could boost investor sentiment and drive up stock indices
lead_story: The recent de-escalation in Iran has led to a plunge in oil prices, which in turn has caused US Treasury yields to fall. This development has boosted investor sentiment and could lead to a stronger dollar. As a result, the US stock market is expected to open higher on Monday.
